# Experiment log

The single record of every experiment. **Append-only.** One row per experiment, ids `exp-001` onward.

## Rules

- **An entry is REQUIRED before a run starts** (hypothesis + config) and **completed after** (metrics). No experiment exists unless it is in this log.
- **No metric claim anywhere without a log entry** to cite.
- A **"this improved"** claim requires the *same evaluation set* as the baseline it is compared against.
- This log is how parallel sessions coordinate — read the last entries before starting any experiment work.

Favouring the 7B: over-decomposition (+0.1283) and break_EM (-0.0217). SARI, GED, ROUGE-L, step_f1 and ordered_step_accuracy are all statistically indistinguishable. **What size buys is granularity and chaining, not wording.** The 14B is the only arm in the block with a significantly higher net granularity accuracy than another arm (hop_EM 0.6167), it nearly eliminates under-decomposition (0.1017 from the 7B's 0.2933 — the block's largest effect at p=7.32e-23), and it chains near-perfectly and uniformly across hops (0.9838; 0.9800/0.9838/0.9875 at 2/3/4, where the 7B collapses to 0.8775 at 2 hops).
